rows.label: DETERMENT

rows.label: TRAFFIC LIGHT

rows.label: EPITAPH

rows.label: DOLLAR MARK
rows.clue: A symbol of commercialism or greed

rows.label: OUTBURST

rows.label: VIRGULE

rows.label: ABRACADABRA

rows.label: SPARRING

rows.label: DIRECTIVE

rows.label: SUBPOENA

rows.label: SHOP TALK

rows.label: ACRONYM
rows.clue: A word formed from the initial letters of the several words in the name

rows.label: PRINTOUT

rows.label: RADIOGRAM
rows.clue: A message transmitted by wireless telegraphy

rows.label: RATIOCINATION

rows.label: CONTRACT OFFER

rows.label: DEBRIEFING
rows.clue: Report of a mission or task

rows.label: HONOR
rows.clue: A tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction

rows.label: PRIMER
rows.clue: An introductory textbook

rows.label: INPUT PROGRAM
rows.clue: A utility program that organizes the input to a computer

rows.label: CONTENT WORD

rows.label: COLLOQUIALISM
